user.title: Road to Weight Goal
user.description: One entry tracks one person. You can add more entries later.

data_description.source_entity: A sensor that reports a weight in kilograms, for example from a smart scale. Leave empty to enter weights by hand.
data_description.goal_mode: The value you pick is the one you set; the other one is calculated from it.

abort.already_configured: An entry with this name already exists.

data_description.tolerance: How far the weight may deviate from the plan before the status changes.
data_description.overdue_days: Days without a measurement before the reminder fires. 0 switches the reminder off.
data_description.max_jump: Measurements that differ from the previous one by more than this are ignored and logged. 0 accepts every value.
data_description.recalculation_interval: Only needed if you plot the sensor history in a third party chart card. 0 recalculates at midnight and after every measurement.
data_description.allow_manual_entry: Let the manual weight entity record measurements. Off by default when a weight source is configured, because an accidental value is awkward to remove. Always on when there is no source.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Optional actions that run in addition to the events on the event bus. Leave empty to use only the events.

error.invalid_range: The lowest plausible weight must be below the highest.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the weight was measured. Defaults to now.

set_goal.name: Set goal
set_goal.description: Changes several goal values at once.

target_weight.name: Target weight
target_weight.description: Only accepted when the goal is defined by target weight.

rate_per_week.name: Change per week
rate_per_week.description: Only accepted when the goal is defined by change per week.

reset_goal.name: Reset goal
reset_goal.description: Clears the goal. Recorded weights are kept.

ignore_last_measurement.name: Ignore last measurement
ignore_last_measurement.description: Removes the most recent measurement from the trend, the projection and the status. The recorder keeps its own copy, so the point stays in long term history.

days.name: Days
days.description: Only return measurements from the last few days.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Fills the internal history from weights Home Assistant already recorded, so the trend and the projection work straight away.

source_entity.name: Source
source_entity.description: Entity to read from. Defaults to the configured weight source.

replace.name: Overwrite
replace.description: Replace values that are already in the internal history. Weights you entered by hand are never overwritten.

write_statistics.name: Write long term statistics
write_statistics.description: Also backfill the long term statistics of this integration's weight sensor, so past weights show up in history graphs. Writes into the recorder database; can be undone under Developer tools, Statistics.

delete_measurement.name: Delete measurement
delete_measurement.description: Removes a single measurement from the internal history. The recorder keeps its own copy, so the point stays in the short term history graph.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the measurement was recorded. Use the get_measurements action to look it up.

tolerance_minutes.name: Tolerance
tolerance_minutes.description: Match the closest measurement within this many minutes.

derived_value.message: This value is calculated from the others. Change the goal mode in the options if you want to set it directly. Current mode: {mode}.

no_target.message: No Road to Weight Goal entity was targeted.

nothing_to_change.message: Pass at least one goal value.

no_source_entity.message: No weight source is configured and none was passed to the action.

no_recorder.message: The recorder is not available, so there is no history to import.

no_weight_entity.message: The weight sensor of this entry was not found, so no statistics can be written.

manual_entry_disabled.message: Manual entry is switched off because a weight source is configured. Turn it back on under Configure, Settings.

no_measurement_found.message: No measurement was found near that timestamp.

nothing_to_confirm.message: There is no weight waiting to be confirmed. Enter one first.
